title.zh: 在南甘马粦省Libmanan市镇设立繁育站并授权拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a Breeding Station in the Municipality of Libmanan, Province of Camarines Sur, and to Authorize Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish a Breeding Station in the Municipality of Libmanan, Province of Camarines Sur, and to Authorize Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trạm Nhân giống tại Thị trấn Libmanan, Tỉnh Camarines Sur, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสถานีเพาะพันธุ์ในเทศบาล Libmanan จังหวัด Camarines Sur และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Stasiun Pembibitan di Kotamadya Libmanan, Provinsi Camarines Sur, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Stesen Pembiakan di Perbandaran Libmanan, Wilayah Camarines Sur, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5272_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Bureau of Animal Industry, a breeding station in the Municipality of Libmanan, Province of Camarines Sur, at a site to be selected by the Director of the Bureau of Animal Industry with the assistance of the Municipal Mayor and District Engineer, to be known as the Libmanan Breeding Station.

Upon recommendation of the Director of Animal Industry, the President of the Philippines shall set aside and reserve such portion of the public land located within the Municipality of Libmanan as may be necessary and convenient for the establishment of said breeding station.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purchase of breeding animals, supplies and materials and such other expenses as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
